chunks: "A sacrifice is not performed on behalf of one who is in the womb."

key_terms.الْبَطْنِ: the womb, meaning the unborn child still in the mother's belly
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: honorific meaning peace be upon him
key_terms.عَلِيٌّ: Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام, the speaker of this ruling
key_terms.يُضَحَّى: to offer a sacrifice on someone's behalf

ai.seo_question: Is a sacrificial offering performed on behalf of an unborn child in the womb?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling from Imam Ali عليه السلام concerning sacrificial offerings. It states that an unborn child in the womb is not included as one on whose behalf the sacrifice is offered.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3061 – Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"A sacrifice is not performed on behalf of one who is in the womb."
